item.description: 1. Nonconvulsive status epilepticus with coma is the most powerful predictor of death and poor neurologic recovery, regardless of the underlying cause. item.title: Oral nonstatin medication significantly lowers cholesterol in high-risk patients
item.description: 1. In this randomized controlled trial, once-daily oral enlicitide was associated with sustained reductions in low-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels compared to placebo among those at high risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. 2. Enlicitide also lowered non-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, apolipoprotein B, and lipoprotein(a) levels without notable safety differences between groups.
